payload.name: Preserve Distinct Event Facts Alongside Opinions
payload.description: Use during extraction when a message mixes a general opinion, agreement, or sentiment with a specific personal event such as a past trip or activity.
content: When a message contains both a general opinion/agreement and a specific factual event (e.g., 'This was my ... trip last year'), extract the event as its own candidate memory rather than capturing only the sentiment.
Resolve relative time phrases like 'last year' from the message/session timestamp and record the resolved date on the event candidate.
Extract only the distinct claims explicitly stated; do not infer extra details, and stop once the opinion and the specific event are each captured as separate candidates.

solves: Construction extraction sometimes collapses a message that mixes an opinion or agreement with a specific personal experience, dropping the concrete event (e.g., a past trip) because the sentiment dominates. This Skill ensures each explicitly stated factual claim is preserved as its own candidate, with relative time resolved from the session timestamp.
